content: Re Hagloy Kala Yael Deus

Hami rewol bisiy, towe yoh le ibe hapatpat ngalugmi le yebe wochog yai hapatpat ngalir rechokla ye mel Espritu Santus uwor; ye tugul le ibe hapatpat ngalugmi le yebe wochog yai hapatpat ngalir yarmetael faileng le. Hami ila ha chil wochog yalwich irel lepal yami medaf irel tugulul ladep le yar Kristiano.
Irel yodwe ngo milik mele iholugmi bo ha ted fel le habe mongoy. Igla mwo ngo ha ted fel,

bo ha chil mel le hami yarmetael faileng le. Yodla habe rol loltomay fengal, ngo ha rol hachocho fengal, ila ngo yete ikla mekla ye hallehaloh le hami yarmatael faileng le ngo hasa dabey wegdeg kala yar?
Yodla semal hami yebe sor bo, “Ngang choluwal Paulus”, ngo semal be sor bo, “Ngang choluwal Apollos”, — ila ngo hated dabey mekla wegdigir rechokla re togla Deus?
Itey le Apollos? Ngo itey le Paulus? Hamem chog yael Deus re hagloy le ha pepalugmi bo habe chepar. Semal gich ngo ye foru yengang kala Samol ye fang ngali bo yebe foru.
Ngang mele ifadgu faesol ire we ngo Apollos mele yema yidfi ngal chael, iwe ngo Deus mele ye foru bo yebe tumul fedah we.
Yeramtala yema fedagu mo yeramtala yema yidfi fedah we ila tor pelar. Deus mele yor pelal bo iy mele ye foru bo yebe tumul fedah we.
Tor mele ye dil mo llepdal yeramtala yema fod mo yeramtala yema yidfi fedah we. Deus yebe fang paliyer le be dabey lepal mekla semal mo semal ir ye foru.
Bo hamem chog chol sew yengang le ha yengang ngal Deus, ngo hami mele milay la yael Deus. Ngo wol hami imw la imwel Deus.

Iteptap kkefang la yael Deus le ye fang ngalyey, iwe isa foru yengang kala yar salap irel yai feta sew dayif. Iwe ngo semal yesa budoh fatlah uwol. Iwe ngo semal ngo yebe kemahoy hamayu igegel yal fatlah.
Sa mol yael Deus yitol le Jesus Kristus mele dayif, ngo tayor sew dayif le yebe chil ffaor mo solbos.
Tot yarmat re bele teptap hoal hare silver hare feas ka ye changcheng bo rebe hassu wol dayif la; ngo tot ila rebe teptap ire hare fadil.
Momayel yael semal mo semal yengang ila be llah irel Ralla be tefaeldoh Kristus iyang. Irel Ralla ngo yaef ye bele hagla ngo ye kawraloh mala halongol igegel yael semal mo semal yengang.
Hare te fisngeg mala semal ye fatleha mo wol dayif la, ila ngo be yor paliyel yal yengang.
Iwe ngo hare ye fisngegloh mala semal ye fatleha ila ngo towe yor paliyel yengang la yal. Ngo iy llufulyal ila yebe daor le be wochog molwe ye cheway mo luwul yaef.
Ye tugul bo ha gola le hami ila yael Deus templum ngo Espritu Santus ila ye mel uwomi!
Ila semal le be hatawsi templum la yael Deus ngo Deus yebe lliyloh. Bo templum la yael Deus ila ye santus ngo hami mele yal templum.
Tor semal le ma iy chog yal kacchepra. Hare yor semal mo luwullumi le ye luluwaley ngo ye gola pangal meka repiyer re faileng le, ngo yebe yitli le tor mele iy ye gola, ila ngo yebe yoh ngali repiy.
Bo mala yarmetael faileng le re yitli bo ila mala repiy, ila tor loh pelal mo irel Deus. Babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Deus ye dorfir rechokla re sor bo re repiy luwul yar machohchoh”;
ngo babior we ye santus ye wol sor bo, “Samol ye gola le luluwal kala yar rechokla re repiy ila tor pelal.”
Ila tor semal le yebe habos irel meka ma yoh le yarmat rebe foru: Mala halongol igegal ila pangal formel ngo yami,
le Paulus mo Apollos mo Pedrus mo faileng le mo molow mo maes mo igla mo wagey. Pangalloh meka ngo yami,
iwe ngo hami ila Kristus mele ye lamlugmi iwe ngo Deus mele ye lamli Kristus.
